item.title: Halloumi beats pharmaceuticals in Cyprus exports as trade deficit hits €8 billion
item.description: Cyprus’s trade deficit widened by €606 million in 2025 to reach €8 billion, driven by a nearly €1 billion surge in imports despite rising exports, preliminary data from the Statistical Service shows.
